speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The beef has been in the pot since before the first collect, and I am not carrying it up the stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sat, Mistress. Threepence for the board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence is threepence, Easter or not. The day does not pay your dinner.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There's rosemary on your shoe, sir. Shall I brush it, or is it meant to stay?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. The church floor was strewn with it. It will walk itself off.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I was three places from you at the rail. You took the bread. You took the cup. You said nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There was nothing to say. I confessed nothing. The law was kept, and the day was kept.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You came home quiet. I shall not ask what you confessed. You have already said the whole of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Master Thwaite turned the sand-glass twice. I counted. Is the beef for the table, or for the men?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: For the table. Carry the loaf, Alse, and do not set it by the notch.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I was not going to. You said not today.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The loaf you would not measure is smaller than Christmas's.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It is Easter, Master Verbeke. A woman may leave a loaf alone one day in the year. The baker may not take that for a pardon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Smaller than Christmas, and still a penny. I will eat it. I will not put it on a board to prove you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Gib, off the bench. The cat has had more of my patience this winter than the loaf has.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He will be on the chronicle by afternoon, sir. He likes the heavy one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He may have the chronicle. The other book is shut. I am not copying a line out of either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two books, and a king you will not tell me. I judged the comedy once. I am not asking again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You judged it once. That was enough for it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The man three places from me smelled of the dye-house. He did not speak either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are all quiet, and we shall eat while the beef is hot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating it hot. It has been a long time of fish.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the king the one in the shut book, sir?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. The shut book is another man's wars. Mine is upstairs. John of Gaunt is in it, and he is not coming down.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take the beef, and leave John of Gaunt upstairs. I am not feeding a court.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: He may stay upstairs. The loaf is here, and it is smaller, and that is enough for a feast.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: May I have the end with the crust?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You may. The cups can go down when you are done. There is no speech today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thank you for the beef, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Lent is over. Do not make a sermon of a boiled piece. Eat.
